data.title: Visa is cutting 7% of employees in efficiency push as AI reshapes work
data.description: Visa plans to cut about 7% of its workforce, or roughly 2,600 employees, as CEO Ryan McInerney seeks to streamline the payments giant.
data.author: Hugh Son
